style: Hand-inked map illustration for a parchment adventure map of a reactor greenhouse. Flat single-color dark sepia ink (#3E3022) with slightly rough brush edges, like a stamp or woodcut printed on old paper. No other colors, no gradients, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers. Transparent background unless stated otherwise. Original design, do not imitate existing games.

assets.prompt: A vertical strip of old yellow-olive parchment paper (#C9C08A to #B8AE78, subtle darker blotches and faint teal-green mould speckles), filling the full height edge to edge with NO top or bottom border so it can tile vertically. The LEFT and RIGHT edges are torn and irregular with a few dark ink splatters near the edges; outside the torn edges is fully transparent. Low contrast, calm, no drawings, no lines, no text. This is an exception to the single sepia color rule: use the parchment colors described.
A small round robot head icon with two angry eye slits and a tiny antenna, front view, compact and bold.
A fierce horned robot skull icon with big jagged pincer jaws and angry eyes, bolder and more menacing than a normal enemy, front view.
A bold question mark drawn inside a round coin-like disc, thick brush stroke.
A merchant icon: a tied coin sack with a small sprout growing from its knot.
A small closed treasure chest icon, side-front view, with a metal band and lock.
A campfire icon with three flames above crossed logs.
A big menacing boiler-robot face icon with a greenhouse dome on its head and a grill mouth, framed by a spiky ring.

assets.brief: boss illustration at the top of the map
assets.prompt: A large ink illustration of the act boss 'Mother Pot': a massive egg-shaped nursery boiler robot with a glass greenhouse dome on top, pipe handles like hips, a belly hatch and little seedling robots peeking out, sitting on a cloud of billowing steam. Drawn in the single sepia ink with light hatching, like an illustration printed on a map. Front view, centered.
